admission.sentence: Admission: 769 reaction candidates, 188 admitted to the trade band and the chart reads (163 by the 4% scan, 25 by the dollar scan on a range-expansion, higher-volume day); 581 came through the dollar scan alone without one and are research only. Of the 129 mechanical A-band names without a veto, 39 are admitted and 90 are not. Admission is read off the recorded discovery route and the checklist's own range-expansion and volume checks; it is never a grade, and the chart reader never sees a name it stops.

registry.coverage_note: A bounded manual registry of known cash-acquisition events, not a live news feed, exhaustive corporate-action screen, or clearance of unlisted stocks. Each event records its own source dates and manual review date. Unresolved events stay excluded after review_due and require a new source review; expected closing dates and go-shop deadlines never automatically clear a stock.

Cash reuse: US stock trades generally settle T+1; a sale does not establish immediately spendable cash. Check availability and any cash-account restrictions with your broker.
Cash-account planning reference: no leverage is assumed. The site does not read your broker's settled cash or buying power; confirm available settled cash before each buy.
Plan a protective stop-market order as soon as the buy fills; verify your broker supports the intended entry and linked stop orders. Gaps and slippage can make the loss exceed planned risk.
